RECIPE CARD - AF-12 anti-rust alkyd enamel
1. Charge 520 kg long-oil alkyd resin AL-60 (Resine Altamira) into
2. Add 170 kg basic lead chromate pigment CL-77 (Cromopigmenti
3. Add 0.2 kg soy lecithin with the pigment.
4. Add 0.8 kg ammonium chloride per 1000 kg batch, dissolved in 2 L
5. Disperse at 1,400 rpm to fineness 6 Hegman minimum.
6. Let down with 160 kg white spirit.
7. Add 4.5 kg cobalt drier flakes dissolved in xylene and 2 kg MEKO.
8. Rest batch 12 h in holding tank before QC sample.
9. Filter through 80 µm sieve and fill 20 L tins.
